 Joe Burrow’s model girlfriend Olivia Ponton causes stir with vacation photos
 Joe Burrow's model girlfriend Olivia Ponton is enjoying Madrid ahead of the Bengals-Falcons game. 
 By 
 Andrew McCarty 
 | 
 November 6, 2026 
 Feb 18, 2024; Santa Monica, CA, USA; Olivia Ponton a model and influencer photographed backstage at the 2024 People s Choice Awards on Sunday, Feb. 18, 2024 at the Barker Hangar in Santa Monica, Calif. Mandatory Credit: Robert Hanashiro-USA TODAY Credit: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect (Reuters) 
 Cincinnati Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is playing the best football of his career as the team carries a three-game winning streak into Sunday’s game against the Atlanta Falcons in Madrid.
 While his attention is on the game, Burrow is still finding some time to enjoy the team’s trip to Spain. He can finally escape, even though he did get recognized by a group of Americans studying abroad.
 “I usually expect to go pretty incognito and not have anybody recognize me,” he said, per Cincinnati radio host Mike Petraglia on X . “It’s a little bit more than that, but I love being out here because I can feel like a normal person for a little bit.”
 Burrow isn’t the only one enjoying Madrid, though.
 MORE: Olivia Ponton, Livvy Dunne steal spotlight in behind-the-scenes Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show photos 
 Joe Burrow’s model girlfriend in Madrid
 Feb 18, 2024; Santa Monica, CA, USA; Olivia Ponton a model and influencer photographed backstage at the 2024 People s Choice Awards on Sunday, Feb. 18, 2024 at the Barker Hangar in Santa Monica, Calif. Mandatory Credit: Robert Hanashiro-USA TODAY via Reuters Connect (Reuters) 
 Model Olivia Ponton , who has posed for Sports Illustrated Swimsuit, among other things, posted a series of photos from Madrid. 
 “Somewhere past my bedtime. Thank you @theprincipalmadrid for the warm welcome,” she said in the caption of the photos on Instagram showing Ponton enjoying a balcony photoshoot and a few shots of her food and hotel room from throughout the night.
 MORE: Joe Burrow’s model girlfriend Olivia Ponton catches attention with Halloween costume 
 The next morning, she posted a video on TikTok. She and a friend attempted to hunt down a tasty matcha latte.
 MORE: Joe Burrow’s model girlfriend Olivia Ponton reveals personal health battle 
 Burrow and Ponton have kept their relationship mostly private, so it’s unclear if she’ll be attending Sunday’s game against the Falcons.
 Cincinnati meets Atlanta at 9:30 a.m. ET Sunday on NFL Network.
